hints.title: Separate the signs
hints.body: Suppose the entries receiving plus signs sum to `P` and the entries receiving minus signs sum to `N`. Then `P - N = target` and `P + N = total`.

hints.title: Turn it into subset sum
hints.body: Adding the equations gives `2P = total + target`, so the problem is to count subsets whose sum is `(total + target) / 2`.

hints.title: Validate first
hints.body: If the target's absolute value exceeds the total, no assignment works. If `total + target` is odd, the required subset sum is not an integer. Both cases return zero.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
total = sum(values)
if abs(target) > total or (total + target) is odd:
    return 0
wanted = (total + target) / 2
ways = zeros of length wanted + 1
ways[0] = 1
for value in values:
    for subtotal from wanted down to value:
        ways[subtotal] += ways[subtotal - value]
return ways[wanted]
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
